newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece signs 2.3 bln drs deal with Rhodes casino.
newsitem.headline: Greece signs 2.3 bln drs deal with Rhodes casino.

text.p: Greek Development Minister Vasso Papandreou signed a contract worth 2.3 billion drachmas with a consortium of Greek and foreign firms to build and operate a casino on the island of Rhodes, development ministry officials said.

The Rhodes casino consortium includes Playboy Enterprises with 16 percent, Greek construction firm Michaniki with 33 percent, state Commercial Bank of Greek through its Enias subsidiary with 33 percent, the Haragionis group with 16 percent and Roslyn Geronikolos with 5.0 percent.

Michaniki expects its turnover to rise by 4.0 billion drachmas from the renovation of the Rhodes Hotel where the casino will be housed and revenues of 20 billion at current prices in the first 12 years of operations, Melina Emfietzoglou, head of public relations at Michaniki, said.
Renovation works at the hotel will be completed in a year, she said.
